title: Ontology concept (PRD §3.1)
description: One concept record inside an Ontology class file. Truth anchor: the artifact. Canonical O-000001 through O-999999 identities are immutable and independent of class names, filenames and reclassification. Unpublished records use typed proposal keys. Source pointers remain the authority; prose is navigation. The active store-file envelope is version 2.

subjects.description: Optional whole-record subject assignments, in authored order with no primary position. Absent means unknown; an empty array explicitly records none. IDs must be canonical S identities, including on proposal records. Duplicate IDs are rejected by the engine convention. Assignment shape does not establish registry membership, eligibility or approval.

id.description: Canonical O identity, or an exact proposal:ontology:<lowercase-v4-uuid> authoring key. Canonical lookup never accepts proposal keys.

class.description: Per-project classification metadata. A class or filename does not allocate an identity range.

source-of-truth.description: File OR folder paths into the repo. Multi-entry semantics (§3.5): the first entry is the primary owner; additional entries are secondary references only. Every enumerates descriptor's source must name a listed entry. Point at a folder for identity, at a file for facts.

used-by.description: Typed refs; must resolve (checked by the structural validator).

status.description: §3.5 semantics: draft/proposed = structural checks only; active = all checks blocking-grade; deprecated = pointer/value checks demote to warnings.

enumerates.description: OPTIONAL — presence makes the concept rung-2 (value agreement, diffed both ways).

enumeratesDescriptor.description: The claim of an enumerable value set plus the extractor recipe to re-derive it. A malformed descriptor is a hard error, never skipped (PRD §4).

kind.description: Extractor kind name (e.g. ts-const-array, swift-enum, dir-modules). Open set: clients author later kinds.

source.description: Must name a listed source-of-truth entry (§3.5).

symbol.description: Declaration symbol inside the source, where the kind needs one.

emit.description: Which facet the kind emits where both are legitimate (e.g. Swift case names vs raw values, §3.5).

pattern.description: dir-modules option: filename filter over the directory listing (e.g. `*.route.ts`). Grammar: `*` matches any run of characters, everything else is literal, the whole name must match. Presence pins the FILE facet — without it the kind emits subdirectory names.

strip.description: dir-modules option: suffix removed from every emitted name (strip `.route.ts`: home.route.ts → home). A facet name that does not carry the suffix is a hard error, never emitted unstripped.

values.description: Strings only, compared byte-exact and case-sensitive, as sets (§3.5). YAML 1.1 coercion is a real trap (no → false, on → true): quote such values. The loader hard-errors on non-string scalars.

storeFile.description: Ontology class-file envelope. Every store file carries schema-version (§3.5); evolution is additive-only.
